column2: The token will be a copy of the front face and it won't be able to transform.
column3: Outdated in part ("it won't be able to transform"): written 2011-09-22, when a copy of a double-faced card copied only its face that was up and only transforming double-faced cards could transform (still so in the CR effective 2023-02-03). The CR effective 2023-04-14 (March of the Machine) added 707.8a: a token copy of a transforming double-faced card is a transforming token with both faces, which can transform. The rest (the front face's mana cost is paid; the token copies the front face) is cited in tests/rulings/r_p077_graveyard_cards.rs. See docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md.
